title: Draw shape tool, edit shape tool, shape state machines

sections.heading: DRAW TOOL STATE MACHINE
sections.content:
The shape creation workflow in ProBuilder is governed by a finite state machine architecture centered around the abstract base class `ShapeState` and three concrete state subclasses: `ShapeState_InitShape`, `ShapeState_DrawBaseShape`, and `ShapeState_DrawHeightShape`.

1. Finite State Machine Lifecycle and Structure:
- `ShapeState` base class:
  - `public static ShapeState s_defaultState`: Static reference to the entry/reset state (`ShapeState_InitShape`).
  - `[SerializeReference] public ShapeState m_nextState = null`: Polymorphic pointer to the subsequent state in the sequence.
  - `public static DrawShapeTool tool`: Static reference to the driving `DrawShapeTool` instance.
  - `StartStateMachine()`: Invokes `s_defaultState.InitState()` and returns `s_defaultState`.
  - `InitState()`: Protected virtual hook executed whenever a state becomes active.
  - `DoState(Event evt)`: Abstract event processor handling input events (`EventType.MouseDown`, `EventType.MouseDrag`, `EventType.MouseUp`, `EventType.MouseMove`, `EventType.KeyDown`, `EventType.Repaint`) and returning the next active `ShapeState`.
  - `EndState()`: Protected virtual hook executed before exiting a state.
  - `NextState()`: Invokes `EndState()`, verifies `m_nextState` (falls back to `ResetState()` if null), calls `m_nextState.InitState()`, triggers `SceneView.RepaintAll()`, and returns `m_nextState`.
  - `ResetState()` / `ResetTool(DrawShapeTool t)`: Destroys temporary `tool.m_ProBuilderShape.gameObject` if instantiated, re-initializes `s_defaultState`, repaints the scene view, and returns `s_defaultState`.
- Tool Initialization (`DrawShapeTool.InitStateMachine`):
  - Instantiates `ShapeState_InitShape`, `ShapeState_DrawBaseShape`, and `ShapeState_DrawHeightShape`.
  - Assigns `ShapeState.tool = this` and `ShapeState.s_defaultState = initState`.
  - Links transitions cyclically: `initState.m_nextState = drawBaseState`, `drawBaseState.m_nextState = drawHeightState`, and `drawHeightState.m_nextState = initState`.
  - Enters the state machine via `ShapeState.StartStateMachine()`.

2. State 1: `ShapeState_InitShape` (Awaiting Plane Selection & Placement Click):
- Initialization (`InitState`):
  - Sets `tool.m_IsShapeInit = false`.
  - Allocates 6 bounding box face descriptors (`m_Faces = new EditorShapeUtility.FaceData[6]`).
  - Resets `m_HitPosition = Vector3.positiveInfinity`.
  - Disables the `MeshRenderer` on the duplicate preview object (`tool.m_DuplicateGO`).
- Active Editing of Previously Created Shape:
  - If `tool.m_LastShapeCreated != null`, forwards GUI interaction to `EditShapeTool.DoEditingHandles(tool.m_LastShapeCreated, tool)` so the user can interactively resize and reorient the most recent shape without switching tools.
  - If `evt.isKey && evt.type == EventType.KeyDown && evt.keyCode == KeyCode.Return`, restores the persistent tool via `ToolManager.RestorePreviousPersistentTool()` and calls `ResetState()`.
- Plane and Surface Raycasting:
  - If `EditorHandleUtility.SceneViewInUse(evt)` is true (e.g. orbiting camera with Alt), returns `this` immediately.
  - When `evt.isMouse && HandleUtility.nearestControl == tool.controlID`:
    - Calls `EditorHandleUtility.FindBestPlaneAndBitangent(evt.mousePosition, tool.m_DuplicateGO)` to resolve the active 3D plane (`res.item1`) and bitangent forward direction (`res.item2`).
    - Raycasts against `res.item1` to determine hit point.
    - Validates cardinal plane normal via `Math.IsCardinalAxis(planeNormal)` and checks grid alignment (`offGrid |= Mathf.Abs(snapVal[i] % center[i]) > epsilon`), setting `tool.m_IsOnGrid = !offGrid`.
    - Computes snapped hit position: `m_HitPosition = tool.GetPoint(ray.GetPoint(hit))`.
- State Transition:
  - On `EventType.MouseDown` with `evt.button == 0`:
    - Initializes tool plane: `tool.m_Plane = res.item1`, `tool.m_PlaneForward = res.item2`, `tool.m_PlaneRight = Vector3.Cross(tool.m_Plane.normal, tool.m_PlaneForward)`.
    - Initializes bounding box corners: `tool.m_BB_Origin = m_HitPosition`, `tool.m_BB_HeightCorner = tool.m_BB_Origin`, `tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner = tool.m_BB_Origin`.
    - Returns `NextState()` to transition to `ShapeState_DrawBaseShape`.
- Visualization:
  - Calls `tool.DoDuplicateShapePreviewHandle(m_HitPosition)` to display duplicate shape ghost preview when Shift is held.
  - On `EventType.Repaint`, if `GUIUtility.hotControl == 0`, draws placement preview dot `Handles.DotHandleCap` at `m_HitPosition`.

3. State 2: `ShapeState_DrawBaseShape` (Dragging 2D Base Footprint):
- Initialization (`InitState`): Resets `m_IsDragging = false`.
- Event Handling:
  - Cancellation: `KeyCode.Delete` or `KeyCode.Escape` key down returns `ResetState()`.
  - Dragging: `EventType.MouseDrag` or `MouseMove` with `evt.button == 0`:
    - Sets `m_IsDragging = true` and disables `tool.m_DuplicateGO` renderer.
    - Raycasts cursor ray against `tool.m_Plane` to compute world distance.
    - Computes offset `deltaPoint = ray.GetPoint(distance) - tool.m_BB_Origin`.
    - Converts offset into local plane orientation: `deltaPoint = Quaternion.Inverse(tool.m_PlaneRotation) * deltaPoint`.
    - Snaps displacement via `deltaPoint = tool.GetPoint(deltaPoint, EditorSnapSettings.snapEnabled)`.
    - Updates opposite base corner: `tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner = tool.m_PlaneRotation * deltaPoint + tool.m_BB_Origin`.
    - Sets `tool.m_BB_HeightCorner = tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner` and calls `tool.RebuildShape()`.
  - Completion (`EventType.MouseUp` with `button == 0`):
    - Shift-Click Instant Duplicate: If `!m_IsDragging && evt.shift`, calls `CreateLastShape()` (instantiates shape, applies last size and parameters, rebuilds, selects GameObject) and returns `ResetState()`.
    - Minimum Size Abort: If `Vector3.Distance(tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner, tool.m_BB_Origin) <= Mathf.Min(0.01f, tool.minSnapSize)`, returns `ResetState()`.
    - Records center offset: `tool.m_LastNonDuplicateCenterToOrigin = Quaternion.Inverse(tool.m_PlaneRotation) * ((tool.m_BB_Origin - tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner) * 0.5f)`.
    - Returns `NextState()` to transition to `ShapeState_DrawHeightShape`.

4. State 3: `ShapeState_DrawHeightShape` (Extruding 3D Height):
- 2D Shape Bypass: If `tool.m_ProBuilderShape.shape is Plane` or `tool.m_ProBuilderShape.shape is Sprite`, height definition is bypassed immediately by returning `ValidateShape()` (which calls `NextState()`).
- Event Handling:
  - Key Input: `KeyCode.Space`, `KeyCode.Return`, or `KeyCode.Escape` calls `ValidateShape()` to commit the shape at current height. `KeyCode.Delete` calls `ResetState()` to discard creation.
  - Height Dragging (`MouseMove` / `MouseDrag`):
    - Constructs mouse ray `HandleUtility.GUIPointToWorldRay(evt.mousePosition)`.
    - Computes closest 3D point between the extrusion axis ray (origin `tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner`, direction `tool.m_Plane.normal`) and cursor ray using `Math.GetNearestPointRayRay(tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner, tool.m_Plane.normal, ray.origin, ray.direction)`.
    - If rays are parallel (`dot == 0`), computes delta as `ray.origin - tool.m_Plane.ClosestPointOnPlane(ray.origin)`; otherwise `heightPoint - tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner`.
    - Converts delta to local plane space: `deltaPoint = Quaternion.Inverse(tool.m_PlaneRotation) * deltaPoint`.
    - Snaps height delta: `deltaPoint = tool.GetPoint(deltaPoint, EditorSnapSettings.snapEnabled)`.
    - Updates height corner: `tool.m_BB_HeightCorner = tool.m_PlaneRotation * deltaPoint + tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner`.
    - Invokes `tool.RebuildShape()`.
  - Mouse Up (`EventType.MouseUp` with `button == 0`):
    - Updates `tool.m_LastNonDuplicateCenterToOrigin = Quaternion.Inverse(tool.m_PlaneRotation) * ((tool.m_BB_Origin - tool.m_BB_HeightCorner) * 0.5f)`.
    - Returns `ValidateShape()`.
- State Termination (`EndState`):
  - Detaches selection change handler (`tool.handleSelectionChange = false`).
  - Registers undo operation: `UndoUtility.RegisterCreatedObjectUndo(shape, "Draw Shape")`.
  - Sets `tool.m_ProBuilderShape.gameObject.hideFlags = HideFlags.None`.
  - Initializes mesh: `EditorUtility.InitObject(tool.m_ProBuilderShape.mesh)`.
  - Finalizes geometry: `tool.RebuildShape()`.
  - Selects created shape: `Selection.activeObject = shape`.
  - Collapses undo operations into a single group via `Undo.CollapseUndoOperations(group)`.
  - Persists active shape index and parameters: `DrawShapeTool.s_ActiveShapeIndex.value = ...`, `tool.SaveShapeParams(tool.m_ProBuilderShape)`.
  - Sets `tool.m_LastShapeCreated = tool.m_ProBuilderShape` and clears `tool.m_ProBuilderShape = null`.
  - Transitions back to `ShapeState_InitShape`.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot 4, an EditorPlugin handles 3D viewport input via `_forward_3d_gui_input(Camera3D viewport_camera, InputEvent event)`. A state machine enum (`INIT`, `DRAW_BASE`, `DRAW_HEIGHT`) manages transitions. Ray-plane intersections map mouse coordinates via `camera.project_ray_origin` and `camera.project_ray_normal` with `Plane.intersects_ray`. Closest points on two 3D rays use vector cross-product geometry.

sections.heading: MOUSE INTERACTION
sections.content:
ProBuilder translates 2D mouse cursor coordinates in the SceneView into 3D geometric operations using a multi-tiered plane resolution hierarchy, followed by plane-local drag projections for width/depth and height extrusion.

1. Plane Determination Hierarchy (`EditorHandleUtility.FindBestPlaneAndBitangent`):
When the user moves or clicks the mouse, ProBuilder determines the active 3D drawing plane and bitangent alignment vector in the following strict priority order:
- Priority 1: Picked Scene Mesh or Terrain Surface (`GetPlaneFromPickedObject`):
  - Calls `HandleUtility.PickGameObject(mousePosition, false, ignorePicking.ToArray())`.
  - If a hit `GameObject` contains a `MeshFilter` with a valid `sharedMesh`:
    - Executes `UnityEngine.ProBuilder.HandleUtility.MeshRaycast(HandleUtility.GUIPointToWorldRay(mousePosition), go, out hit)`.
    - Constructs the plane using the transformed hit normal and point: `plane = new Plane(go.transform.TransformDirection(hit.normal), go.transform.TransformPoint(hit.point))`.
    - Derives the bitangent forward vector via `GetBitangent(plane.normal)`.
  - If the hit `GameObject` contains a `Terrain`:
    - Runs `Physics.Raycast(HandleUtility.GUIPointToWorldRay(mousePosition), out hit)`.
    - Plane is `new Plane(hit.normal, hit.point)`, and bitangent aligns with terrain forward or up (`Mathf.Abs(Vector3.Dot(plane.normal, forward)) > .9f ? go.transform.up : forward`).
- Priority 2: ProGrids Active Axis Grid (`GetPlaneFromProGridsAxis`):
  - If `ProGridsInterface.IsActive()` and `ProGridsInterface.GridVisible()` are true:
    - If `ProGridsInterface.IsFullGridEnabled()` is active: raycasts against 3 orthogonal planes (`Vector3.right`, `Vector3.up`, `Vector3.forward`) positioned at ProGrids pivot (`ProGridsInterface.GetPivot`), selecting the plane with the smallest raycast distance.
    - Otherwise queries single active axis (`HandleAxis.X`, `HandleAxis.Y`, `HandleAxis.Z`) and applies `ProGridsInterface.GetActiveGridOffset()` along that axis normal.
- Priority 3: SceneView Grid Plane (`GetPlaneFromSceneView`):
  - If `EditorSnapSettings.gridSnapActive` or `SceneView.lastActiveSceneView.showGrid` is enabled:
    - Queries active grid axis `sceneView.sceneViewGrids.gridAxis` and pivot `sceneView.sceneViewGrids.GetPivot(axis)`.
    - Inverts normal if camera forward dot normal > 0 (`normal *= -1f`).
    - Validates camera side: if `plane.GetSide(cameraTransform.position)` is true, returns this plane.
- Priority 4: Scene Camera Projection Fallback (`GetPlaneFromCameraDirection`):
  - Computes camera pitch `pitch = Mathf.Abs(Vector3.Dot(cameraDirection, Vector3.up))`.
  - If pitch < 0.02f (indicating orthographic or side perspective), sets projection axis to `ProjectionAxis.X` or `ProjectionAxis.Z` based on `right > forward`.
  - Otherwise uses `ProjectionAxis.Y` (horizontal floor plane).
  - Returns `new Plane(Projection.ProjectionAxisToVector(axis), EditorSnapping.MoveSnap(SceneView.lastActiveSceneView.pivot))`.

2. Base Dimensioning via Plane Raycast (Width and Depth):
- In `ShapeState_DrawBaseShape.Drag(Vector2 mousePosition)`:
  - Generates world ray `Ray ray = HandleUtility.GUIPointToWorldRay(mousePosition)`.
  - Intersects with tool plane: `tool.m_Plane.Raycast(ray, out distance)`.
  - Calculates world offset: `var deltaPoint = ray.GetPoint(distance) - tool.m_BB_Origin`.
  - Transforms offset into plane local rotation space: `deltaPoint = Quaternion.Inverse(tool.m_PlaneRotation) * deltaPoint`.
  - Snaps local coordinates: `deltaPoint = tool.GetPoint(deltaPoint, EditorSnapSettings.snapEnabled)`.
  - Updates bounding box opposite corner: `tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner = tool.m_PlaneRotation * deltaPoint + tool.m_BB_Origin`.
  - Sets `tool.m_BB_HeightCorner = tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner`.
- Bounding Box Computation (`DrawShapeTool.RecalculateBounds`):
  - Computes diagonal vector `var diag = m_BB_OppositeCorner - m_BB_Origin`.
  - Projects diagonal onto plane vectors: `var forward = Vector3.Dot(diag, m_PlaneForward.normalized)`, `var right = Vector3.Dot(diag, m_PlaneRight.normalized)`.
  - Computes local height: `var localHeight = Quaternion.Inverse(m_PlaneRotation) * (m_BB_HeightCorner - m_BB_OppositeCorner); var height = localHeight.y;`.
  - Calculates final 3D bounds: `m_Bounds.size = forward * Vector3.forward + right * Vector3.right + height * Vector3.up`.
  - Calculates bounds center: `m_Bounds.center = m_BB_Origin + 0.5f * (m_BB_OppositeCorner - m_BB_Origin) + 0.5f * (m_BB_HeightCorner - m_BB_OppositeCorner)`.
  - Applies slight Y offset if `Mathf.Abs(m_Bounds.center.y) < 0.0001f` to prevent Z-fighting with drawing surface.

3. Height Dimensioning via Ray-to-Ray Closest Point:
- In `ShapeState_DrawHeightShape.DoState(Event evt)`:
  - Casts mouse ray `Ray ray = HandleUtility.GUIPointToWorldRay(evt.mousePosition)`.
  - Projects mouse ray onto the height line extending from `tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner` along `tool.m_Plane.normal` using `Math.GetNearestPointRayRay(tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner, tool.m_Plane.normal, ray.origin, ray.direction)`.
  - Handles parallel grazing angle: checks `dot = Vector3.Dot(tool.m_Plane.normal, ray.direction)`. If `dot == 0`, delta is `ray.origin - tool.m_Plane.ClosestPointOnPlane(ray.origin)`; otherwise `heightPoint - tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner`.
  - Transforms delta to local plane rotation space: `deltaPoint = Quaternion.Inverse(tool.m_PlaneRotation) * deltaPoint`.
  - Snaps height: `deltaPoint = tool.GetPoint(deltaPoint, EditorSnapSettings.snapEnabled)`.
  - Updates height corner: `tool.m_BB_HeightCorner = tool.m_PlaneRotation * deltaPoint + tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner`.
  - Rebuilds geometry via `tool.RebuildShape()`.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot 4, plane raycasting is performed with `plane.intersects_ray(ray_origin, ray_dir)`. The ray-to-ray closest point algorithm for height extrusion corresponds to finding the parameter t along the extrusion normal line that minimizes distance to the camera ray.

sections.heading: GRID SNAPPING
sections.content:
ProBuilder integrates grid and incremental snapping across all phases of shape drawing and shape editing.

1. Snapping Properties and Queries:
- `gridSnapEnabled => true`: Virtual property on `DrawShapeTool` and `EditShapeTool` signaling to Unity's `ToolManager` to activate grid snapping handles.
- `minSnapSize`: Computes the minimum snapping threshold:
  - If `m_IsOnGrid` is true: returns `Mathf.Min(EditorSnapping.activeMoveSnapValue.x, Mathf.Min(EditorSnapping.activeMoveSnapValue.y, EditorSnapping.activeMoveSnapValue.z))`.
  - If `m_IsOnGrid` is false: returns `Mathf.Min(EditorSnapping.incrementalSnapMoveValue.x, Mathf.Min(EditorSnapping.incrementalSnapMoveValue.y, EditorSnapping.incrementalSnapMoveValue.z))`.

2. Point Snapping Method (`DrawShapeTool.GetPoint`):
- Signature: `public Vector3 GetPoint(Vector3 point, bool useIncrementSnap = false)`.
- Step 1: If `useIncrementSnap` is true, returns `ProBuilderSnapping.Snap(point, EditorSnapping.incrementalSnapMoveValue)`.
- Step 2: If `m_IsOnGrid && EditorSnapSettings.gridSnapActive`, returns `ProBuilderSnapping.Snap(point, EditorSnapping.activeMoveSnapValue)`.
- Step 3: Otherwise returns the un-snapped `point`.

3. Plane On-Grid Detection (`ShapeState_InitShape`):
- When a hit plane is identified, ProBuilder checks whether the plane itself aligns with the active grid:
  - Verifies if the plane normal is cardinal: `Math.IsCardinalAxis(planeNormal)`.
  - Calculates plane center: `planeCenter = res.item1.normal * -res.item1.distance`.
  - Applies normal masking: `Vector3 center = Vector3.Scale(ProBuilderSnapping.GetSnappingMaskBasedOnNormalVector(planeNormal), planeCenter)`.
  - Compares against active snap increment: `for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) offGrid |= Mathf.Abs(snapVal[i] % center[i]) > epsilon` (with `epsilon = .00001f`).
  - Sets `tool.m_IsOnGrid = !offGrid`. For non-cardinal surfaces (e.g. angled mesh faces), `m_IsOnGrid` is false, switching the tool to incremental snapping.

4. Base and Height Snapping Application:
- Base footprint: In `ShapeState_DrawBaseShape.UpdateShapeBase`, `deltaPoint = tool.GetPoint(deltaPoint, EditorSnapSettings.snapEnabled)` snaps the local plane X and Z coordinates before rebuilding mesh bounds.
- Height extrusion: In `ShapeState_DrawHeightShape.DoState`, `deltaPoint = tool.GetPoint(deltaPoint, EditorSnapSettings.snapEnabled)` snaps the extrusion height along the plane normal.
- Degeneracy Guard: In `ShapeState_DrawBaseShape.DoState` and `DrawShapeTool.RebuildShape`, if `Vector3.Distance(tool.m_BB_OppositeCorner, tool.m_BB_Origin) <= Mathf.Min(0.01f, tool.minSnapSize)` or `m_Bounds.size.sqrMagnitude <= Mathf.Min(.01f, minSnapSize * minSnapSize)`, the shape creation aborts or clears geometry to prevent zero-volume artifacts.

5. EditShapeTool Handle Snapping (`EditShapeTool.DoSizeHandles`):
- When dragging face size handles on existing shapes:
  - If `Math.IsCardinalAxis(proBuilderShape.transform.up) && EditorSnapSettings.gridSnapEnabled && !EditorSnapSettings.incrementalSnapActive && !evt.alt`:
    - World face position: `facePosition = s_StartPositionGlobal + Vector3.Scale(delta, s_StartScaleInverse)`.
    - Snapping value: `snapValue = Vector3.Scale(Vector3.Scale(EditorSnapping.activeMoveSnapValue, s_StartScaleInverse), Math.Abs(face.Normal))`.
    - Snaps world position: `facePosition = ProBuilderSnapping.Snap(facePosition, snapValue)`.
    - Adjusts target size: `targetSize += Vector3.Scale((facePosition - s_StartPositionGlobal), s_Direction)`.
  - Incremental Snapping: If incremental snapping is active or the shape transform is non-cardinal, uses `snapValue = EditorSnapSettings.incrementalSnapActive ? Vector3.Scale(Vector3.Scale(EditorSnapping.activeMoveSnapValue, s_StartScaleInverse), Math.Abs(face.Normal)) : Vector3.zero; targetSize += ProBuilderSnapping.Snap(delta, snapValue)`.

6. ProGrids Integration:
- In `EditorHandleUtility.GetPlaneFromProGridsAxis`, ProBuilder interfaces directly with ProGrids via reflection:
  - `ProGridsInterface.IsActive()`: Checks if ProGrids plugin is running.
  - `ProGridsInterface.GridVisible()`: Verifies grid visibility.
  - `ProGridsInterface.GetPivot()`: Obtains active ProGrids origin point.
  - `ProGridsInterface.IsFullGridEnabled()`: Determines if 3-axis snapping is active.
  - `ProGridsInterface.GetActiveGridAxis()` / `GetActiveGridOffset()`: Retrieves single-axis grid plane and offset distance.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot 4, snap increments are configured via editor settings (`editors/3d/grid_map_snap_settings` or snap step variables). Grid snapping is implemented using `snappedf(val, step)` or `Vector3.snapped(Vector3.ONE * step)`.

sections.heading: SHAPE SELECTION
sections.content:
ProBuilder manages primitive shape types through attribute-driven reflection, dedicated tool subclasses, preference serialization, and parameter propagation.

1. Shape Discovery and Reflection:
- `EditorShapeUtility.availableShapeTypes`: Scans assemblies via `TypeCache.GetTypesWithAttribute<ShapeAttribute>().Where(t => t.BaseType == typeof(Shape)).ToArray()`.
- `EditorShapeUtility.shapeTypes`: Extracts display names from `((ShapeAttribute)Attribute.GetCustomAttribute(x, typeof(ShapeAttribute))).name`.
- `EditorShapeUtility.shapeTypesGUI`: Constructs grouped `GUIContent[]` lists (up to `s_MaxContentPerGroup = 6` items per group) loading custom icons from `"Tools/ShapeTool/" + name` with the tooltip `"Click and drag to place and scale the shape, or SHIFT+click once to duplicate last size settings."`.

2. Tool Subclasses and Menu Actions:
ProBuilder provides 12 specialized subclasses of `DrawShapeTool`, each exposing a menu item under `Tools/ProBuilder/Editors/Create Shape/<ShapeName>`:
- `CreateCubeTool`: Shortcut `%#K` (Cmd+Shift+K / Ctrl+Shift+K), priority 0.
- `CreateSphereTool`: Priority 1.
- `CreatePlaneTool`: Priority 2.
- `CreateCylinderTool`: Priority 3.
- `CreateConeTool`: Priority 4.
- `CreatePrismTool`: Priority 5.
- `CreateStairsTool`: Priority 6.
- `CreateTorusTool`: Priority 7.
- `CreatePipeTool`: Priority 8.
- `CreateArchTool`: Priority 9.
- `CreateDoorTool`: Priority 10.
- `CreateSpriteTool`: Priority 11.
Each subclass maintains shape-specific preferences:
- `Pref<Vector3> m_LastSize = new Pref<Vector3>("ShapeBuilder.LastSize.<Name>", Vector3.one)`
- `Pref<Quaternion> m_LastRotation = new Pref<Quaternion>("ShapeBuilder.LastRotation.<Name>", Quaternion.identity)`
- `Pref<PivotLocation> m_PivotLocation = new Pref<PivotLocation>("ShapeBuilder.PivotLocation.<Name>", PivotLocation.Center)`
In `OnActivated()`, the tool updates `s_ActiveShapeIndex.value = Array.IndexOf(EditorShapeUtility.availableShapeTypes, typeof(TargetShape))`.

3. Inspector & Overlay Dropdown Integration:
- In `ProBuilderShapeEditor.DrawShapeParametersGUI`:
  - Determines active shape index across multi-selection via `HasMultipleShapeTypes`. If mixed, shows `-1`.
  - Draws dropdown via `m_ActiveShapeIndex = EditorGUILayout.Popup("Shape", m_ActiveShapeIndex, EditorShapeUtility.shapeTypes)`.
  - When the selection changes, resolves target `Type type = EditorShapeUtility.availableShapeTypes[m_ActiveShapeIndex]`.
  - For each selected `ProBuilderShape`, records undo via `UndoUtility.RecordComponents<Transform, ProBuilderMesh, ProBuilderShape>` and replaces the active shape instance via `proBuilderShape.SetShape(EditorShapeUtility.CreateShape(type))`.

4. Parameter Preservation and Reset:
- Caching System (`EditorShapeUtility`):
  - `s_Prefs`: Static `Dictionary<string, Shape>` indexed by `"ShapeBuilder." + type.Name`.
  - `ResetPrefs()`: Instantiates each non-abstract `Shape` subclass and retrieves stored settings via `ProBuilderSettings.Get(name, SettingsScope.Project, instance)`.
  - `SaveParams<T>(T shape)`: Copies current shape fields via `data.CopyShape(shape)` and persists to `ProBuilderSettings.Set(name, data)`.
  - `CopyLastParams(Shape shape, Type type)`: Copies cached properties into `shape` using `shape.CopyShape(data)`.
  - `CreateShape(Type type, bool copyLastParams = true)`: Instantiates `Activator.CreateInstance(type)` and invokes `CopyLastParams`.
- Parameter Behavior Across Shape Switches:
  - Primitive-specific parameters (such as `Stairs` step count, `Arch` angle/radius, `Cylinder` axis/sides) remain preserved in `s_Prefs` for each individual shape class.
  - Overall dimensions (`size`), world center position, and internal orientation (`shapeRotation`) are preserved on the `ProBuilderShape` component when changing shape types.
  - 2D vs 3D Dimension Adaptation (`ProBuilderShape.SetShape`):
    - If transitioning to a flat 2D shape (`Plane` or `Sprite`), `size.y` and `m_LocalCenter.y` are set to `0`.
    - If transitioning from a 2D shape to a 3D shape (`wasFlat && !isFlat`), if `Mathf.Abs(m_Size.y) < k_MinHeight` (0.0001f), `m_Size.y` is restored to `1f`.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot 4, a custom `EditorProperty` or toolbar `OptionButton` can populate registered shape classes. Resource schemas or dictionary caches preserve per-primitive parameters in `ProjectSettings` or `EditorInterface.get_editor_paths().get_config_dir()`.

sections.heading: EDIT SHAPE TOOL
sections.content:
The `EditShapeTool` provides direct in-scene interactive handles to modify bounding dimensions and internal orientation of existing `ProBuilderShape` instances.

1. Tool Activation and Lifecycle:
- Class: `sealed class EditShapeTool : EditorTool` with attribute `[EditorTool("Edit Shape", typeof(ProBuilderShape))]`.
- Menu Entry: `Tools/ProBuilder/Edit/Edit Shape` (validated if any selected object contains a `ProBuilderShape`).
- Overlay Window: Renders `SceneViewOverlay` titled `"Shape Settings"` hosting `DrawShapeGUI()` and `DrawShapeParametersGUI(null)`.
- Mode Change Listeners: Subscribes to `ProBuilderEditor.selectModeChanged` and `ToolManager.activeContextChanged` to restore the previous persistent tool when exiting shape editing context.

2. Handle Setup and Face Data Extraction (`DoEditingHandles`):
- Transformation Matrix: Configures Handles scope to `Matrix4x4.TRS(proBuilderShape.shapeWorldCenter, proBuilderShape.transform.rotation, Vector3.one)`.
- Bounding Face Calculation (`EditorShapeUtility.UpdateFaces`):
  - Populates 6 `FaceData` instances representing the bounding box faces: `-X` (0), `+X` (1), `-Y` (2), `+Y` (3), `-Z` (4), `+Z` (5).
  - Each `FaceData` stores `CenterPosition`, `Normal`, `Points` (4 corner vertices), `IsValid`, and `IsVisible`.
  - Face visibility test: `IsVisible` checks `Vector3.Dot(cameraDir, worldDir) < 0` where `worldDir = Handles.matrix.MultiplyVector(Normal).normalized` and `cameraDir` is the camera-to-face vector.
- Control IDs: Allocates 4 control IDs for orientation handles (`k_OrientationControlIDs`) and 6 control IDs for face size handles (`s_FaceControlIDs`).

3. Bounds Face Size Handles (`DoSizeHandles` and `DoFaceSizeHandle`):
- Wireframe Bounding Box: Drawn using `k_BoundsHandleColor` (`Color(.2f, .4f, .8f, 1f)`). Visible faces use alpha 1.0; occluded faces use alpha 0.5.
- Face Dot Cap: Drawn at each `face.CenterPosition` via `Handles.DotHandleCap` with size `HandleUtility.GetHandleSize(face.CenterPosition) * s_DefaultMidpointHandleSize` (0.03f). Highlighted in `EditorHandleDrawing.edgeSelectedColor` when hovered.
- Mouse Drag Line Translation:
  - Computes displacement along world face normal using `HandleUtility.CalcLineTranslation(s_StartMousePosition, evt.mousePosition, s_StartPositionGlobal, trs.TransformDirection(face.Normal).normalized)`.
  - Alt Key Symmetrical Modifier: When Alt is held, `modifier = evt.alt ? 2f : 1f`, expanding both opposing faces symmetrically around the center.
  - Non-Alt Single-Side Drag: Updates the center position by `center = Vector3.Scale((targetSize - s_StartSize) / 2f, s_Direction)` so the opposing face remains fixed in space.
  - Snapping: Snaps `delta` along face normal to active grid or incremental snap increments.
  - Applies properties via `ApplyProperties(proBuilderShape, s_StartCenter + center, targetSize)`, which calls `proBuilderShape.UpdateBounds(bounds)`.

4. Orientation Arrow Handles (`DoOrientationHandles` and `DoOrientationHandle`):
- Applicability: Active on all non-Cube shapes when bounding size in X, Y, and Z > epsilon.
- Hover Detection: When the cursor is inside a visible face (`EditorShapeUtility.PointerIsInFace(face)` via `PointInQuad2D`), orientation arrow handles appear.
- Visual Arrow Construction:
  - Computes 4 arrow polylines (`arrowsLines[4]`) radiating from `face.CenterPosition` toward each edge of the face.
  - Renders polylines via `Handles.DrawAAPolyLine(5f, arrowsLines[i])`.
  - When hovered: sets cursor to `MouseCursor.RotateArrow` and draws shape internal coordinate axes (`shapeRotation * Vector3.up` and `shapeRotation * Vector3.forward`).
- Rotation Execution (on `EventType.MouseUp`):
  - Identifies clicked arrow control ID and extracts `targetedNormal = (arrowsLines[i][1] - face.CenterPosition).normalized`.
  - Calculates rotation axis: `Vector3 rotationAxis = Vector3.Cross(currentNormal, targetedNormal)`.
  - Calculates rotation angle: `var angle = Vector3.SignedAngle(currentNormal, targetedNormal, rotationAxis)`.
  - Constructs quaternion: `s_ShapeRotation = Quaternion.AngleAxis(angle, rotationAxis)`.
  - Applies rotation: `proBuilderShape.RotateInsideBounds(s_ShapeRotation)` (updates `shapeRotation` and rebuilds mesh without changing bounds).

5. Mesh Editability Check and Reset:
- Editability Condition: `proBuilderShape.isEditable` evaluates `m_UnmodifiedMeshVersion == mesh.versionIndex`.
- Manual Mesh Modification: If the user modifies mesh vertices, edges, or faces in ProBuilder, `mesh.versionIndex` increments, making `isEditable` false.
- Reset Workflow: When `!isEditable`, `ProBuilderShapeEditor.DrawShapeGUI` disables parametric editing controls and displays an info HelpBox: *"You have manually modified the selected shape(s). Reset the shape to remove all manual changes in order to proceed."* Clicking "Reset Shape" calls `shapeComponent.UpdateShape()` and restores the parametric shape.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot 4, `EditorNode3DGizmoPlugin` and `EditorNode3DGizmo` handle interactive 3D gizmos. Face handles and orientation arrows can be added via `gizmo.add_handles()` and `gizmo.add_lines()`. When the user drags a handle, `_set_handle()` updates node bounding dimensions.

sections.heading: PIVOT OFFSET
sections.content:
ProBuilder provides explicit control over shape pivot placement relative to bounding geometry, ensuring that pivot locations remain stable and predictable during creation, resizing, and shape switching.

1. Pivot Location Enum and Configuration:
- `PivotLocation` enum (`UnityEngine.ProBuilder.ShapeFactory`):
  - `Center` (0): Positions the transform pivot at the exact geometric center of the shape bounding box.
  - `FirstVertex` (1): Positions the transform pivot at the first corner vertex where the user began drawing (`m_BB_Origin`).
- Configurable in `DrawShapeTool` inspector and SceneView overlay via `tool.pivotLocation = (PivotLocation)EditorGUILayout.EnumPopup(k_ShapePivotLabel, tool.pivotLocation)`.
- Persisted per shape type via `Pref<PivotLocation> m_PivotLocation = new Pref<PivotLocation>("ShapeBuilder.PivotLocation.<ShapeName>", PivotLocation.Center)`.

2. Preview Pivot Calculation (`DrawShapeTool.previewPivotPosition`):
- Computed dynamically during interactive drawing:
  - If `pivotLocation == PivotLocation.FirstVertex`:
    - Computes corner offset: `var pivotOffset = instance.m_PlaneRotation * (instance.m_Bounds.size * -0.5f)`.
    - Returns `pivotOffset + instance.m_Bounds.center`.
  - If `pivotLocation == PivotLocation.Center`:
    - Returns `m_Bounds.center`.
- In `DrawShapeTool.RebuildShape`, calls `proBuilderShape.Rebuild(pivotLocation == PivotLocation.Center ? m_Bounds.center : m_BB_Origin, m_PlaneRotation, m_Bounds)`.

3. Mesh Pivot Assignment and Ratio Tracking (`ProBuilderShape.Rebuild`):
- Parameterized rebuild method: `Rebuild(Vector3 pivotPosition, Quaternion rotation, Bounds bounds)`:
  - Step 1: Sets transform position to `bounds.center` and rotation to `rotation`.
  - Step 2: Assigns `size = bounds.size`.
  - Step 3: Rebuilds primitive geometry: `m_Shape.RebuildMesh(mesh, size, shapeRotation)` and fits mesh vertices via `MeshUtility.FitToSize(mesh, bbox, size)`.
  - Step 4: Shifts vertex positions relative to pivot: `mesh.SetPivot(pivotPosition)`. This translates all mesh vertex coordinates by `transform.position - pivotPosition` and relocates the GameObject transform position to `pivotPosition`.
  - Step 5: Computes local bounding center: `m_LocalCenter = mesh.transform.InverseTransformPoint(bounds.center)`.
  - Step 6: Computes normalized pivot ratio `m_PivotRatio`:
    - `m_PivotRatio = new Vector3(RatioOrZero(m_LocalCenter.x, bounds.size.x), RatioOrZero(m_LocalCenter.y, bounds.size.y), RatioOrZero(m_LocalCenter.z, bounds.size.z))`
    - Where `RatioOrZero(localCenterComponent, sizeComponent)` computes `Mathf.Clamp(localCenterComponent / (sizeComponent * 0.5f), -1f, 1f)` if `Mathf.Abs(sizeComponent) >= 0.0001f`, else `0f`.
    - For `PivotLocation.Center`, `m_LocalCenter` is `(0, 0, 0)` and `m_PivotRatio` is `(0, 0, 0)`.
    - For `PivotLocation.FirstVertex`, `m_LocalCenter` sits at half-extents, yielding `m_PivotRatio` of `(1, 1, 1)` or `(-1, -1, -1)`.

4. Pivot Preservation During Shape Resizing (`ProBuilderShape.UpdateShape`):
- When `ProBuilderShape.size` is modified (via Inspector property or `EditShapeTool` face handles), the shape must resize without shifting its anchored pivot position.
- Algorithm in `UpdateShape()`:
  - Derives new local center: `var newLocalCenter = Vector3.Scale(m_PivotRatio, size * 0.5f)`.
  - Transforms local center to world space: `var newWorldCenter = mesh.transform.TransformPoint(newLocalCenter)`.
  - Rebuilds shape maintaining transform position: `Rebuild(mesh.transform.position, mesh.transform.rotation, new Bounds(newWorldCenter, size))`.
- This ensures that a corner-anchored shape grows outward from the corner without moving the pivot point.

5. Dynamic Pivot Switching on Last Created Shape:
- In `DrawShapeTool.pivotLocation` property setter:
  - If the user changes `pivotLocation` while the most recently created shape is selected in the overlay (`instance.currentShapeInOverlay == instance.m_LastShapeCreated`):
    - Computes `newPivotPosition = lastShape.shapeWorldCenter`.
    - If `value != PivotLocation.Center`, adds `instance.m_PlaneRotation * m_LastNonDuplicateCenterToOrigin`.
    - Invokes `instance.m_LastShapeCreated.Rebuild(newPivotPosition, lastShapeTrs.rotation, lastShape.shapeWorldBounds)`.
    - Updates `shapePivotLocation = value`.
sections.godot_notes: In Godot 4, changing a node's pivot involves translating its mesh vertex positions in `ArrayMesh` surfaces by negative pivot offset while offsetting the `Node3D.global_position` by positive pivot offset. Storing a normalized pivot ratio vector `pivot_ratio` allows automatic recalculation of vertex offsets whenever dimensions change.

cross_references.relationship: Defines primitive Shape classes (Cube, Sphere, Plane, Cylinder, etc.) and the ProBuilderShape component data structures instantiated and edited by DrawShapeTool and EditShapeTool.
Provides specialized polygon (PolyShape) and spline extrusion (BezierShape) creation tools operating alongside DrawShapeTool.
Defines core ProBuilderMesh data structures, version tracking (versionIndex), and SetPivot mesh operations used during shape creation and rebuilding.
Supplies math utilities (Math.IsCardinalAxis, Math.GetNearestPointRayRay, ProBuilderSnapping) utilized by shape state machines and edit handles.
Defines EditorTool infrastructure, ToolManager context switching, and persistent tool restoration.
Manages ProBuilder preference persistence (ProBuilderSettings, Pref<T>) for shape dimensions, rotations, and active shape selection.
Manages undo/redo group collapsing (UndoUtility, Undo.CollapseUndoOperations) for atomic shape drawing and resizing transactions.
